says: In our lint tooling, fabrika/integration-test-name no longer counts tmpdir(), so a plain next/ test that writes into the OS temp folder with no mkdtemp, such as writeFileSync(join(tmpdir(), "x.json"), "{}"), passes, though 0584 counts a temp folder as local disk. Counting tmpdir() when the same file also calls a node:fs write (writeFile, appendFile, mkdir, open, createWriteStream, copyFile, cp, rename, symlink and their Sync forms) or new DatabaseSync would catch it and keep a path-only tmpdir() silent.
proof: A RuleTester run of integrationTestName at 1311809c1 on next/apps/fabrika/src/probe.test.ts holding that writeFileSync line reported no error. The README documents the gap at line 973.
cost: No file in next/ does this today. A future one would run a disk-writing law on pull requests.
